rationale: Single Albanian-language WB blog post on Kosovo digital economy - useful framing evidence, not a standalone feed; parent worldbank.org already covered.
EIB Kosovo project register discloses intermediated loans to Kosovo banks and KCGF at pipeline stage - durable standalone monitoring target.
TED advanced search is the authoritative EU tender/award gazette covering IPA-funded Kosovo financial-sector and IT contracts.
IPA Kosovo financing-programme index is the upstream signal for later TED tenders; distinct function from TED despite shared europa.eu domain.
EU Office in Kosovo publishes local tenders and award notices that never reach TED - non-redundant standalone notice board.
EU communications aggregator best mined once for named Kosovo programmes and implementing partners, then traced to TED/IPA primaries.
WBIF project database continuously discloses blended grant/loan amounts and TA assignments incl. digital-infrastructure window for Kosovo.
KCGF donor and news pages map donor-to-bank money flows and list participating Kosovo lenders on an ongoing basis.
KfW Kosovo project/evaluation pages are valuable and in-scope but URL check failed; re-verify liveness before registering.
SECO co-funds the CBK digital financial services / open-banking programme - high value, but landing URL failed verification, recheck.
GIZ Kosovo project pages plus its tender portal disclose financial-governance and access-to-finance assignments and counterparts.
MCA-Kosovo is mostly energy/workforce but runs published procurement with banking/treasury adjacencies - low-frequency monitoring only.
GEFF partner-bank list is a live register of Kosovo banks holding donor credit lines; URL verification failed, recheck before approving.
d-portal/IATI gives machine-readable donor activity and transaction data filterable to XK sector 240xx - systematic cross-check layer.
OECD DAC CRS via data-explorer is the authoritative long-run baseline for donor money into Kosovo financial intermediaries; lagged but durable.
DevelopmentAid aggregates donor tenders/awards incl. Kosovo bank deals but most detail sits behind paid registration - human must clear access.
UNGM public notice board carries UN-agency digital-finance tenders and awards for Kosovo; public listing, modest yield.
ASEE is the dominant regional core-banking/card vendor behind several Kosovo banks; its product and news pages are a primary vendor-side disclosure channel.
App-store listings and package-name fingerprints continuously reveal Kosovo bank platform vendors and migration dates; highest-yield indirect route.
Montran resources hub confirmed CBK CSD/RTGS supplier identity and keeps publishing customer implementations - monitor the hub, not just this release.
Halcom vendor pages evidence a Raiffeisen Kosovo mobile-bank relationship; regional e-banking supplier worth tracking for renewals/displacements.
Backbase newsroom named Kosovo as an expansion market - early-warning on digital-banking platform competition entering the market.
Printec blog/country pages give supplier-side view of the Kosovo ATM/POS estate; blog URL failed verification, recheck liveness.
Kosovar media publish bank-vendor partnership PR (PriBank/IPKO) found nowhere else; local-language equivalent of vendor press releases despite modest credibility.
IPKO is a named domestic integrator serving Kosovo banks and the likeliest publisher of Kosovo-specific banking references.
Technographics aggregator naming per-bank core-banking purchases (Raiffeisen Kosova/Temenos T24) - mine for leads, verify against primaries.
6sense market-share pages are low-credibility and not Kosovo-specific; only a weak triangulation aid alongside better technographics sources.
e-Prokurimi is the only mandatory structured public record of Kosovo public-body (incl. CBK) IT contract awards naming suppliers and values.
